notes: tapFrac values are computed from the real RectTransforms, not estimated. Canvas reference 1242x2688 with Expand scaling resolves to 1242x2760 on a 1080x2400 device, and AspecterSA letterboxes the panels by 36 units top and bottom, so fracX = panelX/1242 and fracY = (36 + 2688 - panelY)/2760 with panelY measured from the bottom. Every step changes the screen, and the pop opened in step 7 is closed in step 8.
